summary: Address PR review on the composite commands: reject invalid --mode, add --mode to striking-distance, and decouple keyword-gap's target lookup from --limit via --target-limit.
reason: validateCompositeMode now returns an error instead of warning so bad --mode values fail before hitting the API; striking-distance gains the --mode flag for parity with the other composites; keyword-gap fetches your own rankings under a separate --target-limit so keywords ranked beyond the first --limit rows are not reported as false gaps.
